trap.label: -ing no lugar de oração
trap.wrong: The man who stands there is my uncle.
trap.right: The man standing there is my uncle.
trap.why: Em português dizemos "o homem que está parado". Em inglês, a oração relativa pode ser reduzida para -ing sem pronome.

mcq.q: Qual é a forma reduzida de "the girl who is singing"?
Complete: **___** tired, she went to bed.

fix.wrong: The people live here are friendly.
fix.right: The people living here are friendly.

fix.wrong: The cake baking by Mom is delicious.
fix.right: The cake baked by Mom is delicious.

fix.wrong: Walking to school, the rain began.
fix.right: Walking to school, I felt the rain begin.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza: “The man who is waiting is my boss.”
rewrite.answer: The man waiting is my boss.

rewrite.prompt: Reduza: “The book that was written by Tom is long.”
rewrite.answer: The book written by Tom is long.
